name: Operator K-theory and KK-theory
summary: Kasparov links K-homology to elliptic operators.

name: Heat equation proof of index theorem
summary: Heat kernels give local proofs of the index formula.

name: Hida theory: p-adic families of modular forms
summary: Ordinary cusp forms are organised into p-adic analytic families whose Galois representations vary in a Hecke algebra.

name: Explicit expander graphs from property (T) (Margulis)
from: representation theory of Lie groups (Kazhdan property T)
summary: Kazhdan's property (T) for lattices in Lie groups gives the first explicit infinite families of expanding graphs.

name: Symplectic topology
summary: The geometry of phase space is studied by rigidity phenomena, using complex-geometric techniques (holomorphic curves) and Morse-theoretic ones (Floer homology).

name: Superrigidity and arithmeticity of lattices
summary: Ergodic-theoretic arguments on homogeneous spaces force lattices in higher rank semisimple groups to be arithmetic, tying Lie theory, ergodic theory and number theory.

name: Intersection cohomology
summary: Goresky and MacPherson extend Poincare duality to singular spaces.

name: Deligne proof of Weil conjectures
summary: Etale cohomology plus Lefschetz pencils and Rankin methods proved the Riemann hypothesis for varieties over finite fields.

name: Finite-gap integration of soliton equations
from: algebraic geometry (Riemann surfaces, theta functions, Jacobians)
summary: Theta functions of algebraic curves give explicit periodic solutions of KdV and related soliton equations.

name: Furstenberg: ergodic theory proves Szemeredi's theorem
summary: Density statements about integers are translated into recurrence statements for measure-preserving systems and proved there.
